name: SSC Vocabulary 500
description: A focused SSC English vocabulary deck with meanings and memorable example lines for revision.

cards.definition:
Meaning: to reduce or become less intense.

Example: The king decided to abdicate the throne.

Example: The police arrested the thief and his abettor.
